name: B10-0293/2025 (PfE) – Dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Mali, where the transitional authorities dissolved all political parties and banned political activity in May 2025. The Parliament asks for political dialogue and constitutional order to be restored, for free speech and peaceful protest to be protected, and for a coordinated response to jihadist attacks. It also condemns anti-Western rhetoric and urges the European Union to strengthen cooperation with Mali on migration and returns.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position on Mali's crackdown.
- It affects Mali's authorities, opposition and citizens, and European Union migration policy.
- Parliament sends the text to the European Union's foreign policy chief, the Council, the Commission, ECOWAS, the African Union, the United Nations and Mali's authorities.
